summary: Researcher in reinforcement learning for LLM agents, ==tech-leading a team of research engineers== within a 10-person RL group at JetBrains Research where I mid-train and RL-align models ==from 1B to 480B parameters== for agentic software engineering, with hands-on experience from reward design to multi-node training infrastructure. ==20+ publications== across ML and physics venues, including ICLR, NeurIPS, EMNLP, and others.

bullets.label: Team
bullets.text: ==Technical lead== of a team of research engineers within a 10-person RL group. ==Accountable for the team's research direction== and the execution of individual projects, and in charge of the technical stack across them: algorithm research, reward shaping, and multi-node training infrastructure (PyTorch, VeRL, Megatron-LM, NeMo RL).

bullets.label: Code world models
bullets.text: Improving code comprehension of LLMs for use as code world models in agentic SWE workflows. The work spans three directions: ==developing benchmarks== for code comprehension, ==researching linear probes== on hidden states and decision models, and RL training for reasoning and tool use, aimed at codebase comprehension and efficient SWE task solving.

bullets.label: SWE routing models
bullets.text: Trained step-wise 4B–8B routing LLMs with RL, designing rewards that trade reasoning cost against quality; ==shifted the Pareto frontier across major SWE agent scaffolds== by reasoning at every step about which agentic model should handle it.

bullets.label: Environment-setup agents
bullets.text: Post-trained 1B–32B agentic LLMs (SFT + RL) to configure arbitrary repositories; adapted RL algorithms, designed reward shaping, and built Kubernetes evaluation infrastructure, reaching ==state-of-the-art setup quality== and scaling internal SWE benchmarks to hundreds of unique containers for training and evaluation.

bullets.label: Code completion
bullets.text: Post-trained 1B–4B fill-in-the-middle LLMs for code completion with PPO, DPO, and FIM-specific preference-learning variants, ==cutting hallucinations in enterprise codebases== and raising production compilation rates.

roles.title: Researcher
roles.unit: Machine Learning for Software Engineering Laboratory

bullets.label: Notebook ML
bullets.text: Built notebook ML systems for the Datalore and DataSpell teams, from code analysis and user-behavior models to LLM fine-tuning for cell-level completion, ==shipping four production features==.

bullets.label: Open-source tooling
bullets.text: Architected an open-source library for analyzing a 10 TB corpus of Jupyter notebooks; research built on it won the ==ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award==.

Applied evolutionary optimization and physics-informed neural networks to meta-material design, ==surpassing industry-accepted scattering limits==; contributed to ==10+ publications in Nature group, IEEE, and APS journals==.
